The outcome of the Tenno Sho (Autumn) was 
decided. Her eyes closed, King Halo basked 
in the roaring cheers. Then, she set off 
toward a certain destination.

Waiting up ahead were Special Week and 
Seiun Sky, who had just clashed fiercely 
in this heated battle.

Hatred, frustration... and gratitude. They 
clashed with the feelings buried deep 
within their hearts and laughed together.

Between them blew a wind driving ever 
forward, forward. Their race will surely 
carry on. For they are rivals—and 
classmates from the same generation.
